steps: Add the departure city of each traveler.
FlyndMe compares flights with flexible dates and finds the cheapest destination.
Share the result with your group and each traveler books their own flight.

faqs.a: No. We recommend the best destination and each traveler books their own flight directly on Aviasales, Skyscanner or Google Flights.

faqs.q: How do you know if a destination is fair for everyone?
faqs.a: We compare what each traveler pays: you'll see one bar per city and the gap between who pays most and least. With “Most balanced” we rank by the most even split, even if the total is a bit higher.

faqs.q: How many travelers can I add?
faqs.a: Up to 8 departure cities and 16 travelers in total (up to 9 from the same city).
No. They're estimates based on recent searches and may have changed. Before booking you can check the recommended destination's price live, and the final price is the one on the site where you book.
